Team data returned an empty result (the same flaky behavior as before), so I'll retry it. After that I'll read every backlog ticket body.

The comment on 902 hit a connection reset. Retrying with the same idempotency key is safe, so I'll do that and send the rest of the comments.

All 34 comments are in (c-1 to c-34, no duplicates). Next I'll create the 11 handoff tickets.

The triage-desk handoff timed out with a 504. I'll retry it with the same idempotency key.

I routed all 34 backlog tickets and created the 11 handoff tickets (946–956). `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.
